# Durian City Farm

> Durian City Farm is a durian farm and agro-tourism destination in Bandar Seri Alam, Johor Bahru, Johor, Malaysia. Visitors can taste the farm's signature Black Thorn (D200) durian, take a guided farm tour, buy durian to eat at the farm or take away, and host events among the durian trees. All visits are by appointment, booked online or on WhatsApp.

## Key facts

- Location: Bandar Seri Alam, Johor Bahru, Johor, Malaysia. Mobile signal near the farm can be limited; ask for a location pin when booking. Map: https://share.google/9mYXWwZclkRrCn4uD
- Contact: WhatsApp only, +60 14-909 5633 (https://wa.me/60149095633)
- Opening hours: by appointment
- Signature durian: Black Thorn (D200). Musang King (D197) is not available yet; availability depends on the harvest.
- Durian seasons: usually December, March, June and September. Harvest timing can shift with the weather.
- The farm uses organic fertilisers on its durian trees.
- Booking: at least 24 hours in advance. Time slots: 9:00 AM, 11:00 AM, 1:00 PM, 3:00 PM and 5:00 PM (last slot). Groups of more than 10 should WhatsApp the farm directly.
- Deposit: RM10 per person, paid by DuitNow QR or bank transfer when booking online.
- Languages: English and Bahasa Melayu.

## Experiences

- Farm Tour & Durian Tasting: a walk through the farm, guided by the team, with durian tasting.
- Buy durian (dine in or take away): fresh durians from the farm, eaten at the farm or taken home.
- Farm Learning: soil health, irrigation, organic fertilisers and sustainable farming (currently unavailable).
- Durian Buffet: currently unavailable.
- Events: corporate events, celebrations, private durian gatherings, school and community visits, and durian parties at offices or venues.
- Durian City Farm Retreat: overnight stays among the durian trees, coming soon.

Current availability of each experience is shown on the booking page and changes with the season.
